summary_rationale: Cheniere has converted a major U.S. LNG platform into a substantial operating cash generator, supported by long-lived customer agreements, extensive terminal and pipeline infrastructure, rising cargo throughput and a recent record of completing CCL Stage 3 ahead of its guaranteed schedule and within budget. The business remains capital intensive and exposed to global LNG competition, feed-gas and transport constraints, derivative-driven GAAP volatility, substantial debt and noncontrolling interests, and project-level permitting and financing gates. Some critical measures—including standardized train utilization, companywide DSO and a consistently measured realized ROIC-versus-WACC series—are unavailable in the cited public record. The operating franchise is sound but its outcomes remain tied to commodity-linked contracts, project execution and capital discipline.
